questions.q: Anna goes to the market on Saturday.
questions.qZh: 安娜是在星期六去集市的。
questions.why: 第一句说 It is Saturday morning。

questions.q: Anna's mother buys three kilos of apples.
questions.qZh: 安娜的妈妈买了三公斤苹果。
questions.why: 文中说的是 two kilos，两公斤。

questions.q: Anna's father is at the market too.
questions.qZh: 安娜的爸爸也在集市上。
questions.why: 文中只提到了妈妈，没有提到爸爸。

sentences.en: It is Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 星期六早上。

sentences.en: Anna goes to the market with her mother.
sentences.zh: 安娜和妈妈一起去集市。

sentences.en: The market is full of people.
sentences.zh: 集市上人很多。

sentences.en: There are fresh apples, oranges and bread.
sentences.zh: 那里有新鲜的苹果、橙子和面包。

sentences.en: Anna likes the red apples.
sentences.zh: 安娜喜欢红苹果。

sentences.en: Her mother buys two kilos of apples.
sentences.zh: 妈妈买了两公斤苹果。

sentences.en: The apples are not expensive.
sentences.zh: 苹果不贵。

sentences.en: Then they buy bread for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 然后她们买了早餐吃的面包。

sentences.en: Anna says hello to the old seller.
sentences.zh: 安娜向年老的摊主问好。

sentences.en: They go home with a big bag.
sentences.zh: 她们提着一大袋东西回家了。

questions.q: The garden is behind the house.
questions.qZh: 花园在房子后面。
questions.why: 第一句说 behind my house。

questions.q: The writer waters the flowers in the evening.
questions.qZh: 作者晚上给花浇水。
questions.why: 文中说的是 Every morning，每天早上。

questions.q: The writer has a dog in the garden.
questions.qZh: 作者的花园里有一条狗。
questions.why: 文中提到了鸟，没有提到狗。

sentences.en: I have a little garden behind my house.
sentences.zh: 我家后面有一个小花园。

sentences.en: There are red flowers and green trees in it.
sentences.zh: 里面有红色的花和绿色的树。

sentences.en: Every morning, I water the flowers.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，我给花浇水。

sentences.en: The sun is warm and the air is clean.
sentences.zh: 阳光温暖，空气清新。

sentences.en: Birds sing in the trees.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿在树上唱歌。

sentences.en: My garden is quiet and beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我的花园安静又美丽。

sentences.en: In spring, new flowers grow every day.
sentences.zh: 春天里，每天都有新花开放。

sentences.en: I like to read a book in the garden.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢在花园里看书。

sentences.en: My friend comes to see the flowers too.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友也来看花。

sentences.en: We sit under the tree and talk.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在树下聊天。

questions.q: Tom walks to school every day.
questions.qZh: 汤姆每天走路去学校。
questions.why: 文中说他 by bus，坐公交车。

questions.q: The bus comes at half past seven.
questions.qZh: 公交车七点半到。
questions.why: 文中原句就是这样。

questions.q: Tom's school is far from his home.
questions.qZh: 汤姆的学校离他家很远。
questions.why: 文中只说了车程二十分钟，没有说远近。

sentences.en: Tom goes to school by bus every day.
sentences.zh: 汤姆每天坐公交车去学校。

sentences.en: He gets up at seven in the morning.
sentences.zh: 他早上七点起床。

sentences.en: The bus stop is near his home.
sentences.zh: 公交站离他家很近。

sentences.en: The bus comes at half past seven.
sentences.zh: 公交车七点半到。

sentences.en: Tom sits by the window.
sentences.zh: 汤姆坐在窗边。

sentences.en: He can see the city on the way.
sentences.zh: 路上他能看到城市。

sentences.en: The bus ride is about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 坐车大约要二十分钟。

sentences.en: At school, Tom meets his friends.
sentences.zh: 到了学校，汤姆见到朋友们。

sentences.en: They go to class together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起去上课。

sentences.en: Tom likes the morning bus ride.
sentences.zh: 汤姆喜欢早上的这趟车。

questions.q: Grandma makes tea in the afternoon.
questions.qZh: 奶奶下午泡茶。
questions.why: 第一句说 In the afternoon。

questions.q: Grandma drinks her tea very fast.
questions.qZh: 奶奶喝茶喝得很快。
questions.why: 文中说 slowly，慢慢地。

questions.q: Grandma likes coffee more than tea.
questions.qZh: 奶奶比起茶更喜欢咖啡。
questions.why: 文中没有提到咖啡。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, Grandma makes a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 下午，奶奶泡了一杯茶。

sentences.en: The tea is hot and smells very good.
sentences.zh: 茶很烫，闻起来很香。

sentences.en: She puts the cup on the small table.
sentences.zh: 她把杯子放在小桌子上。

sentences.en: Then she sits by the window.
sentences.zh: 然后她坐在窗边。

sentences.en: She drinks her tea slowly.
sentences.zh: 她慢慢地喝茶。

sentences.en: She looks at the trees outside.
sentences.zh: 她看着窗外的树。

sentences.en: A cup of tea makes her feel calm.
sentences.zh: 一杯茶让她感到平静。

sentences.en: I sit with her and we talk.
sentences.zh: 我陪她坐着，我们聊聊天。

sentences.en: Tea time is my favourite time of the day.
sentences.zh: 喝茶的时间是我一天中最喜欢的时间。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, I will make tea for Grandma.
sentences.zh: 明天，我要给奶奶泡茶。

questions.q: The library is big and new.
questions.qZh: 这座图书馆又大又新。
questions.why: 文中说 It is small, old library，又小又旧。

questions.q: The writer goes to the library every Friday.
questions.qZh: 作者每个星期五都去图书馆。
questions.why: 文中说 Every Friday, I go there after class。

questions.q: The librarian is the writer's grandfather.
questions.qZh: 图书管理员是作者的爷爷。
questions.why: 文中只说他是一位和蔼的老人，没有说和作者的关系。

sentences.en: There is an old library on the hill near my school.
sentences.zh: 我学校附近的山上有一座旧图书馆。

sentences.en: It is small, but it has many good books.
sentences.zh: 它很小，但里面有很多好书。

sentences.en: Every Friday, I go there after class.
sentences.zh: 每个星期五，放学后我去那里。

sentences.en: The librarian is a kind old man.
sentences.zh: 图书管理员是一位和蔼的老人。

sentences.en: He always helps me find the books I need.
sentences.zh: 他总是帮我找到我需要的书。

sentences.en: Last week, I read a book about the stars.
sentences.zh: 上周，我读了一本关于星星的书。

sentences.en: The book says stars are like the sun, only very far away.
sentences.zh: 书上说星星就像太阳，只是非常远。

sentences.en: I told my friends about it at school.
sentences.zh: 我在学校把这件事告诉了朋友们。

sentences.en: Now they want to visit the library too.
sentences.zh: 现在他们也想去图书馆看看。

sentences.en: A good book can take you to a new world.
sentences.zh: 一本好书可以带你去一个新世界。

questions.q: It rained on Saturday and Sunday.
questions.qZh: 星期六和星期天都下雨了。
questions.why: 文中说 It rained all weekend，星期天雨只是短暂地停了一会儿。

questions.q: Maria cooked lunch alone.
questions.qZh: 玛丽亚一个人做了午饭。
questions.why: 文中说 they cooked together，是一起做的。

questions.q: Maria's family went to the cinema on Sunday.
questions.qZh: 玛丽亚一家星期天去看了电影。
questions.why: 文中说他们去公园散步，没有提到电影院。

sentences.en: It rained all weekend.
sentences.zh: 整个周末都在下雨。

sentences.en: Maria stayed at home with her family.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚和家人待在家里。

sentences.en: On Saturday, they cooked a big lunch together.
sentences.zh: 星期六，他们一起做了一顿丰盛的午饭。

sentences.en: Maria's grandmother taught her to make rice and soup.
sentences.zh: 奶奶教她做米饭和汤。

sentences.en: The kitchen smelled wonderful.
sentences.zh: 厨房里香极了。

sentences.en: After lunch, they played a word game.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，他们玩了一个文字游戏。

sentences.en: Maria's little brother won the game.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚的小弟弟赢了游戏。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the rain stopped for a short time.
sentences.zh: 星期天，雨短暂地停了一会儿。

sentences.en: They went for a walk in the park.
sentences.zh: 他们去公园散了步。

sentences.en: Maria thinks a rainy weekend at home can be nice too.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚觉得，在家度过一个下雨的周末也可以很美好。

sentences.en: Sometimes, the best journeys are the ones at home.
sentences.zh: 有时候，最好的旅程就在家里。

questions.q: Jack bought the bicycle second-hand.
questions.qZh: 杰克的自行车是二手的。
questions.why: 文中说 second-hand bicycle。

questions.q: Jack rides his bicycle to the next town every day.
questions.qZh: 杰克每天骑车去下一个镇。
questions.why: 文中说 on Sundays, on weekdays he goes by bus。

questions.q: Jack wants a new bicycle next year.
questions.qZh: 杰克明年想要一辆新车。
questions.why: 文中没有提到他想换车。

sentences.en: Jack has an old second-hand bicycle.
sentences.zh: 杰克有一辆旧的二手自行车。

sentences.en: It is blue, and it works very well.
sentences.zh: 它是蓝色的，骑起来很好。

sentences.en: On Sundays, he rides it to the next village.
sentences.zh: 星期天，他骑着它去下一个村子。

sentences.en: The road goes up a small hill.
sentences.zh: 路要上一个小山坡。

sentences.en: At first, Jack was very tired.
sentences.zh: 一开始，杰克觉得很累。

sentences.en: His legs hurt and the wind was strong.
sentences.zh: 他的腿很疼，风也很大。

sentences.en: But after a few weeks, he became stronger.
sentences.zh: 但几周后，他变强壮了。

sentences.en: Now the hill feels easy.
sentences.zh: 现在这个山坡骑起来很轻松。

sentences.en: On the way back, he often stops to watch the sunset.
sentences.zh: 回来的路上，他常常停下来看日落。

sentences.en: Riding a bicycle is a slow journey, but a happy one.
sentences.zh: 骑自行车是一场慢旅程，但很快乐。

questions.q: Grandma checks the apples carefully before she buys them.
questions.qZh: 奶奶买苹果之前会仔细检查。
questions.why: 文中说 She checks every apple before she buys。

questions.q: The market apples cost more than the shop apples.
questions.qZh: 集市上的苹果比商店里的贵。
questions.why: 文中说 the market apples are better and cheaper，又好又便宜。

questions.q: Grandma goes to the market with her daughter.
questions.qZh: 奶奶和女儿一起去集市。
questions.why: 文中说和 granddaughter（孙女）一起去，没有提到女儿。

sentences.en: My grandmother goes to the market every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 奶奶每个星期天早上都去集市。

sentences.en: I often go with her.
sentences.zh: 我经常和她一起去。

sentences.en: She knows all the sellers there.
sentences.zh: 她认识那里的所有摊主。

sentences.en: The apple seller smiles when he sees us.
sentences.zh: 卖苹果的摊主看到我们就笑。

sentences.en: She checks every apple before she buys.
sentences.zh: 买之前，她会一个一个检查苹果。

sentences.en: "Fresh apples are heavy and smell sweet," she says.
sentences.zh: 她说：新鲜的苹果沉甸甸的，闻起来很甜。

sentences.en: She buys apples, oranges and rice for the week.
sentences.zh: 她买了一周要吃的苹果、橙子和米。

sentences.en: The market apples are better and cheaper than the ones in the shop.
sentences.zh: 集市上的苹果比商店里的又好又便宜。

sentences.en: At home, she cooks a big lunch for the whole family.
sentences.zh: 回到家，她给全家人做了一顿丰盛的午饭。

sentences.en: Going to the market with Grandma is my favourite part of Sunday.
sentences.zh: 和奶奶一起去集市，是我星期天最喜欢的事。

passages.title: Going to the Market with Grandma

questions.q: Scientists say our memory works like a video camera.
questions.qZh: 科学家说我们的记忆像一台摄像机。
questions.why: 文中明确说记忆不像录像（not like a video）。

questions.q: Remembering a name is easier when you use it in a conversation.
questions.qZh: 在对话中使用一个名字，更容易记住它。
questions.why: 文中说 Use the name soon, and it stays longer。

questions.q: Older people forget names more than young people.
questions.qZh: 老年人比年轻人更容易忘名字。
questions.why: 文中没有比较不同年龄的人。

sentences.en: Why do we forget people's names?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们会忘记别人的名字？

sentences.en: Scientists say it is very common.
sentences.zh: 科学家说这很常见。

sentences.en: Our memory is not like a video camera.
sentences.zh: 我们的记忆不像一台摄像机。

sentences.en: It does not keep everything we see and hear.
sentences.zh: 它不会把我们看到和听到的都存下来。

sentences.en: We remember things that are important to us.
sentences.zh: 我们记住的是对我们重要的事。

sentences.en: A name is just a sound, so it is easy to forget.
sentences.zh: 名字只是一个声音，所以很容易忘掉。

sentences.en: But there is good news: you can train your memory.
sentences.zh: 但有个好消息：记忆是可以训练的。

sentences.en: When you meet someone new, say their name in a sentence.
sentences.zh: 认识新朋友时，在句子里说出他的名字。

sentences.en: Ask them a question with their name in it.
sentences.zh: 问他一个问题，问题里带上他的名字。

sentences.en: Use the name soon, and it will stay in your memory longer.
sentences.zh: 很快用上这个名字，它在你记忆里留得更久。

sentences.en: Our brain remembers what we use, not what we only hear once.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑记住的是我们用过的东西，而不是只听过一次的东西。

passages.title: Why We Forget Names
passages.titleZh: 为什么我们会忘记名字

questions.q: Li Wei prepared by reading about the company.
questions.qZh: 李伟通过了解这家公司来做准备。
questions.why: 文中说 He read about the company and practised his answers。

questions.q: Li Wei got the job on the same day.
questions.qZh: 李伟当天就得到了这份工作。
questions.why: 文中说 Three days later, they called him，三天后才打电话。

questions.q: The job was in another city.
questions.qZh: 这份工作在另一个城市。
questions.why: 文中没有提到工作地点。

sentences.en: Last month, Li Wei had a job interview.
sentences.zh: 上个月，李伟参加了一次求职面试。

sentences.en: It was for a job in a small company near his home.
sentences.zh: 那是离他家不远的一家小公司的工作。

sentences.en: He prepared for a whole week.
sentences.zh: 他准备了整整一周。

sentences.en: He read about the company and practised his answers.
sentences.zh: 他了解了这家公司，还练习了怎么回答问题。

sentences.en: On the day, he was nervous, but he arrived early.
sentences.zh: 面试那天他很紧张，但他提前到了。

sentences.en: The manager asked him about his experience.
sentences.zh: 经理问了他过去的工作经历。

sentences.en: Li Wei spoke slowly and answered every question.
sentences.zh: 李伟慢慢地说，回答了每一个问题。

sentences.en: At the end, he asked the manager one question.
sentences.zh: 最后，他也问了经理一个问题。

sentences.en: "What will my first month look like?" he asked.
sentences.zh: 他问：我第一个月的工作会是什么样子？

sentences.en: The manager smiled.
sentences.zh: 经理笑了。

sentences.en: Three days later, they called him: he got the job.
sentences.zh: 三天后，他们打来电话：他得到了这份工作。

questions.q: The River Festival has been held for more than a hundred years.
questions.qZh: 河流节已经举办了一百多年。
questions.why: 文中说 more than a hundred years。

questions.q: Only young people take part in the festival.
questions.qZh: 只有年轻人才参加这个节日。
questions.why: 文中说 people of all ages，所有年龄的人都参加。

questions.q: The festival takes place in spring.
questions.qZh: 这个节日在春天举行。
questions.why: 文中说 every summer，每年夏天。

sentences.en: Every summer, our town has a river festival.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天，我们镇上都会举办河流节。

sentences.en: The festival is more than a hundred years old.
sentences.zh: 这个节日已经有一百多年的历史了。

sentences.en: In the morning, boats go down the river.
sentences.zh: 早上，船只顺着河往下走。

sentences.en: People on the boats sing and wave to the crowd.
sentences.zh: 船上的人唱歌，向人群挥手。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, there is music and dancing in the market square.
sentences.zh: 下午，集市广场上有音乐和舞蹈。

sentences.en: Old people teach young people the traditional dances.
sentences.zh: 老人教年轻人跳传统舞蹈。

sentences.en: Families bring food and eat together by the river.
sentences.zh: 家家户户带上食物，在河边一起吃。

sentences.en: In the evening, small lights shine on the water.
sentences.zh: 晚上，小灯在水面上闪烁。

sentences.en: The festival brings people of all ages together.
sentences.zh: 这个节日把所有年龄的人聚在一起。

sentences.en: It helps us remember our history and our home.
sentences.zh: 它帮助我们记住自己的历史和家乡。

questions.q: The forest school has no walls or desks.
questions.qZh: 森林学校没有墙和课桌。
questions.why: 文中说 There are no walls, no desks, only trees。

questions.q: The children stay in the forest school for one day.
questions.qZh: 孩子们在森林学校只待一天。
questions.why: 文中说 one day a week, every week，每周一天。

questions.q: The forest school is the only one in the country.
questions.qZh: 这所森林学校是全国唯一的一所。
questions.why: 文中没有这样说。

sentences.en: In a small town in the north, there is a special school.
sentences.zh: 在北方的一个小镇上，有一所特别的学校。

sentences.en: One day a week, the children learn in the forest.
sentences.zh: 每周有一天，孩子们在森林里上课。

sentences.en: There are no walls, no desks, only trees.
sentences.zh: 没有墙，没有课桌，只有树。

sentences.en: They study science by looking at real plants and animals.
sentences.zh: 他们通过观察真实的动植物来学习科学。

sentences.en: They learn to count by counting birds and leaves.
sentences.zh: 他们通过数鸟和数叶子来学习数数。

sentences.en: They also learn to work together.
sentences.zh: 他们还学习一起合作。

sentences.en: If it rains, they build a small shelter.
sentences.zh: 如果下雨，他们就搭一个小棚子。

sentences.en: The teachers say the children are healthier and happier.
sentences.zh: 老师们说，孩子们更健康、更快乐了。

sentences.en: They breathe clean air and move all day.
sentences.zh: 他们呼吸着干净的空气，整天都在活动。

sentences.en: The forest school is a small step towards a different future.
sentences.zh: 森林学校是走向不同未来的一小步。
